From: Natalie Martin <natalie@insightgrid.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Benchmark download — interested in a walkthrough

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the quick access to the benchmark report — we ran it against a couple of our inference-heavy pipelines and saw some interesting cost/latency delta vs our current provider. I downloaded the full PDF (attached) and would like to schedule a short walkthrough/demo to understand how Redwood would handle our streaming/kv-cache patterns.

A few priorities on our end:
- Keep tail-latency under 150ms for 1k concurrent requests
- Transparent per-token cost metrics for forecasting
- Integration options for our VPC deployment (we have strict egress controls)

We are on Pacific time. I'm available Tue/Wed next week 10:00–12:00 or Thu 14:00–16:00 PST. If any of those work, happy to lock something in. I'll likely bring Mark Patel (CTO) and one of our infra leads.

Thanks,
Natalie Martin
Sr. Data Platform Manager
InsightGrid

Attachment: insightgrid-benchmark-summary.pdf

Hi Natalie — great to hear the report surfaced useful signals. Happy to run a focused walkthrough.

I can do Wed 2028-01-17 10:30–11:00 PST or Thu 2028-01-18 14:00–14:30 PST. Ben (cc) will join for the technical deep-dive on serving/runtime and Laura can cover procurement/next steps if useful.

Agenda (short):
- 10m: high-level architecture & how KV/prefix caching maps to your pattern
- 10m: concrete latency/cost comparisons from your benchmark numbers
- 10m: next steps & rollout options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Can you confirm which slot works for you and who else will join? If neither works, here's a Calendly link with additional slots: https://calendly.com/redwood/intro-demo?month=2028-01

I attached a one-pager with the demo agenda. Once you confirm I'll send a calendar invite with the dial-in and a short pre-demo checklist (sample payloads + a short goal statement helps us focus the session).

Best,
